use_ipv6.description: Enable or disable IPv6 support for mDNS.

use_ipv4.description: Enable or disable IPv4 support for mDNS.

allow_interfaces.description: List of network interface names to allow for mDNS traffic. If empty, all interfaces are allowed.

deny_interfaces.description: List of network interface names to explicitly deny for mDNS traffic. Takes precedence over allow_interfaces.

system_hostname.description: System hostname advertised via mDNS. Default uses the actual system hostname if left as placeholder.

domain_name.description: Local mDNS domain name. Typically `local.` for IPv4/IPv6 link-local zones.

reflector_enabled.description: Enable mDNS reflection between subnets. Use only in controlled environments (e.g., home networks with multiple subnets).

reflect_dns_services.description: Enable reflection of DNS Service Discovery (DNS-SD) services across subnets.

nss_resolve_enabled.description: Enable the nss-resolve module to make mDNS resolution available system-wide (e.g., via gethostbyname).

max_cache_entries.description: Maximum number of mDNS cache entries to store.

max_ttl.description: Maximum TTL (in seconds) for positive mDNS responses.

max_neg_ttl.description: Maximum TTL (in seconds) for negative mDNS responses.

wide_area_enabled.description: Enable wide-area mDNS (disallowed by RFC, use only if you understand the risks).

publish_services.description: Enable publishing of locally registered DNS-SD services.

publish_ptr.description: Publish PTR records for service discovery.

publish_service_types.description: Additional service types to explicitly publish (beyond auto-discovered ones). Each entry is a service type string like `_http._tcp`.

respond_to_interfaces.description: List of interfaces to respond to mDNS queries on (overrides default behavior). If empty, responds on all allowed interfaces.

rlimit_nofile.description: Maximum number of open file descriptors allowed for the Avahi daemon process.

rlimit_nproc.description: Maximum number of child processes the daemon may spawn.
